criteria.name: Identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: OSM way 301932787 is named Wang Hall (WANG); Purdue GIS feature FID 895 independently identifies Wang Hall.
The saved outline is derived from the 17-vertex OSM ring. Structural shell XY bbox agrees with the projected source bbox within 0.000002 m.
Aerial overlay shows OSM follows the visible roof edge more closely than the Purdue GIS ring, although the sources differ by several metres (reported IoU ~0.812).
criteria.deduction: Small deduction because OSM is a community-mapped roof outline, not surveyed wall geometry, and the GIS/aerial boundary remains conflicting.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, scale and dimensions
evidence: Structural footprint dimensions and outline match the projected OSM ring; the evaluated shell bbox differs by only 0.000002 m.

Asset geometry is centered at local XY origin. The manifest source bounds center is [98.29549026489258, 339.91009521484375], matching the planned Placement marker anchor [98.2954902278031, 339.9100960000692].
Master marker integration was not available in this building-only review; planned integration still needs coordinator verification.
criteria.deduction: Campus placement is supported by the exact planned bbox center, but the final master Placement marker and rotation still need integration review.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors and roof form
evidence: Four floors are independently supported by Purdue/CSO descriptions and OSM building:levels=4.
OSM tags height=14.8 m; the manifest massing bounds also top at 14.8 m. The new shell-body Z span is 13.88 m before roof/parapet and is an estimate, not a survey.
Preview roof plan includes a long central skylight and rooftop equipment, consistent with aerial and architect imagery at a schematic level.
criteria.deduction: Exact floor heights and roof elevations are not supported by dimensioned drawings; total evaluated model reaches 15.9 m because of rooftop components, 1.1 m above the OSM tagged height. Roof features remain simplified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances and distinctive architecture
evidence: The model has a red brick texture, pale horizontal bands, repeated divided windows, a central glass panel, entrance canopy and sign, consistent in broad material vocabulary with architect photos.

The central atrium tower in the reference is a distinctive projecting brick pavilion with tall glass, a raised curved/capped top and a recessed entry; the model shows a flush rectangular glazed panel, no raised tower/cap and a broad low canopy. The generated preview visibly shows brick texture behind the central glass, so the atrium opening is not convincingly legible.
Facade reference also has taller, fewer window bays than the many small, squarish repeated units in the model.
criteria.deduction: The recognizable central tower, its projection and cap, window proportions, and atrium transparency are not reproduced closely enough.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability and evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 open reports expected scene Building_massing_wang_hall_wang_0dac5ab and collection Asset_massing_wang_hall_wang_0dac5ab with 9 objects and evaluated mesh geometry.
No linked external libraries were found; materials are procedural and the preview rig is separate from the asset collection.

The audit contains raw OSM/GIS/official/architect/aerial source snapshots, an overlay, two renders, structured evidence and fresh-open validation. Asset SHA-256 checked independently as 740cd96ae5716a9f8ed7d260963449a52c5a36ffbebbcb9167ab92c8872bfe2c.
criteria.deduction: Portability and evidence are strong; coordinator still needs to change the manifest integration class and verify the final placement marker.
